patthana23.44:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.44:2.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na avitakka vicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho avitakka vicāramatto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.44:3.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na avitakka avicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho avitakka avicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā ekavīsa. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na pītisahagataṃ
